| 实验 | 代码版本 | TSR | CAR |
|------|---------|-----|-----|
| mvp_occ_s0 | v1 | 0.904 | 0.832 |
| full_occ_retrain_s0_eval_v2 | v2 | 0.802 | 0.746 |

- D051 门控 mvp_occ_s3 (v2, seed 45) 的判定阈值需重新考虑

- 如果 checkpoint 数量 > 2：删除最旧的，只保留最新 2 个
- 输出日志到 `/root/cleanup_checkpoints.log`

```bash
cat > /root/cleanup_checkpoints.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Auto checkpoint cleanup - keep only latest 2 per experiment
LOG="/root/cleanup_checkpoints.log"
echo "$(date): Starting cleanup" >> "$LOG"

CKPT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints"

for exp_dir in "$CKPT_BASE"/*/; do
    [ -d "$exp_dir" ] || continue
    exp_name=$(basename "$exp_dir")
    
    # List step directories sorted by step number (ascending)
    mapfile -t steps < <(find "$exp_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "step-*" | sort -t'-' -k2 -n)
    
    count=${#steps[@]}
    if [ "$count" -gt 2 ]; then
        # Keep last 2 (highest step numbers), delete the rest
        delete_count=$((count - 2))
        echo "$(date): $exp_name has $count checkpoints, deleting $delete_count oldest" >> "$LOG"
        for ((i=0; i<delete_count; i++)); do
            echo "$(date): Deleting ${steps[$i]}" >> "$LOG"
            rm -rf "${steps[$i]}"
        done
    fi
done

echo "$(date): Cleanup done. Disk: $(df -h /dev/md0 | tail -1 | awk '{print $5}')" >> "$LOG"
EOF
```

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Auto checkpoint cleanup - keep only latest 2 per experiment
LOG="/root/cleanup_checkpoints.log"
echo "$(date): Starting cleanup" >> "$LOG"

CKPT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints"

for exp_dir in "$CKPT_BASE"/*/; do
    [ -d "$exp_dir" ] || continue
    exp_name=$(basename "$exp_dir")
    
    # List checkpoint subdirs sorted by step number (ascending)
    # Format: openvla-7b+...--<exp_name>--<step>_chkpt
    mapfile -t steps < <(find "$exp_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "*_chkpt" | sort -t'-' -k2 -n)
    
    # Also check step-XXXXX format
    mapfile -t steps2 < <(find "$exp_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "step-*" | sort -t'-' -k2 -n)
    
    # Merge both formats
    all_steps=("${steps[@]}" "${steps2[@]}")
    
    count=${#all_steps[@]}
    if [ "$count" -gt 2 ]; then
        # Sort all by modification time, keep newest 2
        mapfile -t sorted < <(ls -dt "${all_steps[@]}" 2>/dev/null)
        delete_count=$((${#sorted[@]} - 2))
        echo "$(date): $exp_name has ${#sorted[@]} checkpoints, deleting $delete_count oldest" >> "$LOG"
        for ((i=2; i<${#sorted[@]}; i++)); do
            echo "$(date): Deleting ${sorted[$i]}" >> "$LOG"
            rm -rf "${sorted[$i]}"
        done
    fi
done
```
